description:
What is This Part?
This is the Engine Rebuild “Complete Gasket & Oil Seal Kit”.
Comes with a “True Graphite” Cylinder Head Gasket and “Natural Cork” Valve Cover Gasket.
This kit also supplies you with the Oil Pump & Crank Shaft Oil Seals, the Valve Stem Oil Seals plus all required Gaskets.
Also comes with Radiator Hose & Clamps
Great Value!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Engine Gaskets
Qty 1 – Exhaust Manifold Gasket
Qty 1 – Intake Manifold Gasket
Qty 1 – Valve Cover Gasket – (Cork)
Qty 1 – Cylinder Head Gasket
Qty 1 – Fuel Pump Gasket
Qty 3 – Carburator Gaskets
Qty 1 – Water Pump Gasket
Qty 1 – Thermostat Housing Gasket
Qty 1 – Oil Pan Gasket – (Cork / Adhesive Backed)
Qty 1 – Oil Pump Gasket
Qty 1 – Oil Seal Housing Gasket
Timing Gaskets & Parts
Qty 1 – Outer Timing Cover Gasket
Qty 1 – Inner Timing Cover Gasket
Qty 2 – O-Ring Grommets
Qty 2 – Rubber Seal, Water Pump
Qty 1 – Cork Seal, Water Pump
Qty 1 – Spring, Timing Tensioner
Qty 1 – Key, Timing Gear
Oil Seals
Qty 1 – Crank Shaft Oil Seal – Front
Qty 1 – Crank Shaft Oil Seal – Rear
Qty 1 – Cam Shaft Oil Seal
Qty 8 – Valve Stem Oil Seals
Distributor
Qty 1 – Distributor Shaft O-Ring
Qty 1 – Distributor Cap Seal
Qty 2 – Distributor Cap Clamps
Washers
Qty 4 – Rubber Washers for Valve Cover Bolt
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
